authorInteractionDocument.scope: The 4 October supplied trial instruction supersedes the earlier unsaved/no-save-control activity rule for these new v020 tasks only. Each task proposes the verified native optional S.notes response interface, with distinct IDs and no required-progress contribution. Previous v010 and full-chapter artifacts remain unchanged.
authorInteractionDocument.registrationStatus: Proposal only. Separate SHA256/UTF8-bounded C.notes title registrations must be considered by the integrator; no original native/configuration file is edited.
authorInteractionDocument.comparisonBehavior: Hints and models are voluntary plain details disclosures. Learners are asked to save a first response before comparing, but no automatic save-to-unlock or access gate is claimed.
authorInteractionDocument.persistenceBoundary: Existing native draft saving, explicit collection, reload and All My Work semantics are source-read evidence. No functional save/reload/All My Work test or integration has occurred. Teacher reading HTML disables controls and includes a separate administrative notice.

nativeStateContract.draftInput: Every input event invokes native change/save to assign S.notes[ID].draft. This is draft persistence, not explicit collection.
nativeStateContract.explicitSave: Nonempty draft.trim() and raw draft.length <=5000 required. Successful native save writes submitted=draft.trim(), at=Date.now(); draft remains.
nativeStateContract.oversize: Native textarea has no maxlength. Oversize draft still persists through input. Explicit collection rejects it via global native status. Do not silently truncate or invent a new limit.
nativeStateContract.reload: Initial restoreNotes restores draft text for every data-note-input ID. It does not reconstruct a per-note saved status sentence; initial status remains generic until interaction.
nativeStateContract.allMyWork: Only notes with nonempty submitted render. Last explicitly saved response appears; if draft.trim()!=submitted, a newer-draft notice appears. C.notes title used if registered, otherwise raw ID.
nativeStateContract.history: Notes store current draft plus last submitted text and timestamp. They do not append practice attempts to S.history. Saving again replaces the last submitted note. Do not promise an attempt ledger or first-try grading.
nativeStateContract.progress: Required progress counts S.history kind=check only. Notes do not count toward required checks.
nativeStateContract.failure: Native change/save clone, revision checking, blocked state, cross-tab event and storage error handling remain owners. No bypass/direct storage writer is permitted.
nativeStateContract.print: Existing All My Work print flow includes collected notes. Static-source inference only; print/reload/save tests pending.
nativeStateContract.namespace: Existing biology30-chapter-17:html:v1 or native LMS-scoped key; do not add a namespace or storage schema.
nativeStateContract.hintAndModelState: Ordinary details/summary toggles are not recorded as hint-use or first-try state. No such tracking is claimed.

modelComparisonContract.hint: Use ordinary native details/summary for an intentional optional hint. Include all needed task stimulus before the response.
modelComparisonContract.model: Use a separate ordinary native details/summary for full model, criteria and explanatory feedback. Author instruction may ask learner to save first, then compare.
modelComparisonContract.saveGate: No generic S.notes model-unlock mechanism exists. Do not set data-locked=true: it would never unlock for a new note. data-extension-model queries only the first matching element and is hardcoded to ch17-optional-extension.
modelComparisonContract.honestUIStatement: Comparison is learner-controlled, not technically save-gated. If enforced save-gating is required later, it is a new runtime change requiring a separate integration decision and tests; not part of this teaching-only proposal.

pendingNativeUIChecks: Fresh draft is blank; label targets textarea; status target exists.
Typing saves draft; reload restores it.
Blank and >5000-character explicit collection reject with native feedback; no silent truncation.
Successful collection appears in All My Work with registered title, exactly the last saved response.
Editing later changes draft; All My Work keeps last saved response and newer-draft notice until recollection.
Second collection updates last submitted note without changing required progress or existing notes/history.
Hint/model toggles work by intentional click and are not falsely described as save-gated.
Cross-tab/storage-failure behavior remains native; no new direct storage calls.
Keyboard/label/status and All My Work print behavior verified in actual integrated candidate.
